A university student residence needs schools and universities nearby. The 75th percentile for education is 75.14, rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area.

No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC. The 60-person capacity is not an extracted requirement and is not filtered on.
